fields.description: Maximum days in the past a posting date can be when backdating is allowed. Set to 0 for no limit (any past date allowed).
fields.label: Max Days Back

fields.description: Maximum days into the future a posting date can be when forward dating is allowed. Set to 0 for no limit (any future date allowed).
fields.label: Max Days Forward

fields.description: Document field that holds the posting date. Leave blank to use 'posting_date' (the default for most DocTypes). Set to 'transaction_date' for Purchase Order, or any other custom field name when a future controlled DocType uses a non-standard fieldname. Non-existent or unset fields are silently skipped at validate time, so a wrong value here can't break document saves — it just means the rule won't fire on that DocType.
fields.label: Date Field (override)
